logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate Event
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Idempotency] Duplicate event detected and suppressed. EventKey: ' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.eventKey default '') ++ ' | Tracking: ' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, status: "DUPLICATE_ACKNOWLEDGED", message: "Event already processed and recorded. Duplicate delivery suppressed safely.", eventId: vars.canonicalEvent.eventId, shipmentId: vars.existingEvent[0].shipment_id default "N/A", trackingNumber: vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.canonicalEvent.carrier, normalizedStatus: vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus, isDuplicate: true, isOutOfOrder: false, isPendingUnknown: false, receivedTimestamp: vars.canonicalEvent.receivedTimestamp, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Unknown Shipment
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Unknown Shipment] Tracking number ' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber default '') ++ ' not found in shipments table. Quarantining to pending_tracking_events.']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, status: "QUARANTINED_PENDING_REGISTRATION", message: "Shipment record not found in master database. Event safely quarantined for auto-reconciliation.", eventId: vars.canonicalEvent.eventId, shipmentId: "UNKNOWN", trackingNumber: vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.canonicalEvent.carrier, normalizedStatus: vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus, isDuplicate: false, isOutOfOrder: false, isPendingUnknown: true, receivedTimestamp: vars.canonicalEvent.receivedTimestamp, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Out-of-Order Event
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Out-of-Order] Stale/Older event received for Shipment ' ++ (vars.targetShipment.shipment_id default '') ++ '. Preserving in history without regressing current status: ' ++ (vars.targetShipment.current_status default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, status: "OUT_OF_ORDER_RECORDED", message: "Stale or out-of-order event recorded in audit history. Current shipment status preserved without regression.", eventId: vars.canonicalEvent.eventId, shipmentId: vars.targetShipment.shipment_id, trackingNumber: vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.canonicalEvent.carrier, normalizedStatus: vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus, isDuplicate: false, isOutOfOrder: true, isPendingUnknown: false, receivedTimestamp: vars.canonicalEvent.receivedTimestamp, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

choice.doc:name: Check If Unmapped Status Alert Needed

set-variable.value: #['Unmapped carrier status code \'' ++ (vars.canonicalEvent.originalStatus default '') ++ '\' normalized to EXCEPTION.']
set-variable.doc:name: Set alertMessage

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, status: "EVENT_PROCESSED_SUCCESSFULLY", message: vars.notificationPayload.messageBody default "Shipment event received, normalized, persisted, and evaluated.", customerMessage: vars.notificationPayload.messageBody default "Transit scan recorded. Customer notification suppressed (only major milestones trigger customer alerts).", customerNotification: if (vars.notificationPayload != null) { milestone: vars.notificationPayload.milestone, recipientEmail: vars.notificationPayload.recipientEmail, message: vars.notificationPayload.messageBody, status: "DISPATCHED_TO_CUSTOMER", notificationId: vars.notificationPayload.notificationId } else null, eventId: vars.canonicalEvent.eventId, shipmentId: vars.targetShipment.shipment_id, trackingNumber: vars.canonicalEvent.trackingNumber, carrier: vars.canonicalEvent.carrier, normalizedStatus: vars.canonicalEvent.normalizedStatus, isDuplicate: false, isOutOfOrder: false, isPendingUnknown: false, receivedTimestamp: vars.canonicalEvent.receivedTimestamp, correlationId: vars.correlationId }
